name: Hesperian-Dirge
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by towering mountain ranges near the terminator.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
